ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) and 60% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) geometric mass extending from the peduncle insertion to the median notch; lateral lobes are predominantly high-intensity (white) with dense, irregular low-intensity (black) mottling and focal spotting concentrated along the trailing edge and near the central junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; calculated angle approximately 42 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels along the continuous trailing boundary; notable jaggedness and structural inconsistency at the far-left distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with posterior curvature; trailing edges follow a sigmoidal path transitioning from distal convexity to proximal concavity near the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of localized dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) on the white lobe surfaces; sparse high-intensity (white) punctate spots localized within the central black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the distal-right white lobe, oriented roughly 45 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural truncation and irregular scarring at the distal tip of the left lobe, indicating tissue loss; multiple non-uniform indentations (secondary notches) along the trailing edge of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique low-intensity pigmentation 'drip' extending laterally from the central black mass into the high-intensity field of the left lobe.
